reddit.title: Improving Colony Music Experience in Provincia
reddit.body: We've made significant improvements to the audio experience in Provincia! The music transitions between day, night, title, and combat beds are now smoother than ever, thanks to a long equal-power self-crossfade that prevents hard cuts. This means no more jarring interruptions during gameplay. Check out the full details here: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/soft-music-reloops?utm_source=reddit&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=soft-music-reloops
